WITH overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) AS bowler_count
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match") AS matches,
       COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS played_matches,
       MAX(bowler_count) AS most_bowlers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.ball_by_ball WHERE bowler IS NULL) AS missing_bowlers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored WHERE runs_scored IS NULL) AS unknown_bat_runs,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.extra_runs WHERE extra_runs IS NULL) AS unknown_extras,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored AS s LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) WHERE b.ball_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_bat_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.extra_runs AS e LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) WHERE b.ball_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_extra_rows
FROM overs

SELECT 'missing match record' AS issue, b.match_id, b.innings_no, MIN(b.over_id) AS over_id, COUNT(*) AS deliveries
FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b LEFT JOIN main."match" AS m USING (match_id)
WHERE m.match_id IS NULL
GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no
UNION ALL
SELECT 'unmatched extras', e.match_id, e.innings_no, e.over_id, e.extra_runs
FROM main.extra_runs AS e LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
WHERE b.match_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'no deliveries', m.match_id, NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM main."match" AS m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b WHERE b.match_id = m.match_id)

WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT over_totals.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY match_id
               ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_totals
),
highest_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
           AVG(total_runs) OVER () AS average_highest_over_runs
    FROM ranked_overs
    WHERE over_rank = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT h.match_id, h.innings_no, h.over_id, b.bowler,
       h.total_runs, h.average_highest_over_runs
FROM highest_overs AS h
LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
ORDER BY h.match_id, b.bowler
